card_class: flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-default focus:outline-none rounded-3xl border border-default bg-surface-elevated-secondary @container/approval-card
form_class: flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-2 pb-4 @max-md/approval-card:flex-col @max-md/approval-card:items-stretch
button_ancestor_chain: BUTTON .no-drag cursor-interaction items-center select-none disabled:cursor-default aria
FORM .flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-2 pb-4 @max-md/approval-card:flex-col @
DIV .flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-default focus:outline-none rounded-3xl border
tree: div > div "允许 ChatGPT 使用 Google Drive 吗？" + div > button[type=button] "查看详情"
button[type=button] > span "允许一次" + span > kbd "⏎"
outerHTML: 没存到：浏览器工具把整段 outerHTML 拦下了（里面带会话数据），只存了结构
after_click_check: 5 秒后页面上 approval-card 数 = 0；对话里出现「已使用 Google Drive 集成运行了命令」；它要写的文件出现在 Drive 的目标文件夹里
